7.  **Sooty_Mould** (`leaf/Mango_Leaf_288.jpg`): No match. Confirms sooty appearance, unlike the test image.
8.  **Die_Back** (`stem/Mango_Leaf_147.jpg`): Strong match. This third example further confirms the visual consistency of Die_Back symptoms.

The visual evidence from the reference images points decisively to Die_Back. The symptoms in the test image are a near-perfect match to the Die_Back reference photos and inconsistent with the other candidate diseases.
